@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # ---- hyper parameters ----
    target_speed: float = 2.0        # desired forward speed [m/s]
    speed_temperature: float = 1.0   # temperature of the exponential speed shaping
    align_temperature: float = 0.3   # temperature of the exponential heading alignment
    upright_temperature: float = 0.5
    max_speed: float = 6.0           # speed used to normalize the dense linear term
    w_speed_exp: float = 1.0
    w_speed_lin: float = 0.5
    w_align: float = 0.5
    w_upright: float = 0.1

    # ---- unpack root state ----
    q = root_states[:, 3:7]
    vel = root_states[:, 7:10]

    qw = q[:, 0]
    qx = q[:, 1]
    qy = q[:, 2]
    qz = q[:, 3]

    # body forward axis (body x) in world frame
    fwd_x = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qy * qy + qz * qz)
    fwd_y = 2.0 * (qw * qz + qx * qy)
    fwd_z = 2.0 * (qx * qz - qw * qy)

    # body up axis (body z) in world frame
    up_x = 2.0 * (qw * qy + qx * qz)
    up_y = 2.0 * (-qw * qx + qy * qz)
    up_z = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)

    # horizontal projections (world z is up)
    fwd_norm = torch.sqrt(fwd_x * fwd_x + fwd_y * fwd_y + 1e-8)
    fwd_xh = fwd_x / fwd_norm
    fwd_yh = fwd_y / fwd_norm

    vx = vel[:, 0]
    vy = vel[:, 1]

    # signed forward speed along the facing direction
    fwd_speed = vx * fwd_xh + vy * fwd_yh
    # speed magnitude in the horizontal plane
    speed = torch.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + 1e-8)

    # ---------------- reward components ----------------
    # 1) exponential shaping of the gap between the current and the target forward speed
    speed_gap = torch.clamp(target_speed - fwd_speed, min=0.0)
    speed_exp = torch.exp(-speed_gap / speed_temperature)

    # 2) dense linear reward for the forward speed (pushes beyond the target speed)
    speed_lin = torch.clamp(fwd_speed / max_speed, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # 3) heading alignment: face (and therefore run along) the world forward direction
    heading_cos = fwd_xh   # cosine with world +x
    heading_exp = torch.exp(-(1.0 - heading_cos) / align_temperature)

    # 4) keep the torso upright
    upright = torch.exp(-(1.0 - up_z) / upright_temperature)

    reward = w_speed_exp * speed_exp + w_speed_lin * speed_lin + w_align * heading_exp + w_upright * upright

    align_temperature = 0.3     # temperature of the exponential heading alignment

    w_speed_linear = 0.5

    qz = quat[:, 3]

    fwd_y = 2.0 * (qw * qz + qx * qy)
    fwd_z = 2.0 * (qx * qz - qw * qy)

    up_y = 2.0 * (-qw * qx + qy * qz)
    up_z = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)

    fwd_xh = fwd_x / fwd_norm

    # reward components

    speed_gap = torch.clamp(target_speed - forward_speed, min=0.0)
    forward_speed_exp = torch.exp(-speed_gap / speed_temperature)

             + w_heading * heading_alignment

        "forward_speed_linear": forward_speed_linear,
        "heading_alignment": heading_alignment,
        "world_forward_linear": world_forward_linear,
        "upright": upright,
        "forward_speed": forward_speed,

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # ---- hyper parameters ----
    target_speed: float = 2.0        # desired forward speed [m/s]
    speed_temperature: float = 1.0   # temperature of the exponential speed shaping
    align_temperature: float = 0.3   # temperature of the exponential heading alignment
    upright_temperature: float = 0.5
    max_speed: float = 6.0           # speed used to normalize the dense linear term
    w_speed_exp: float = 1.0
    w_speed_lin: float = 0.5
    w_align: float = 0.5
    w_upright: float = 0.1

    # ---- unpack root state ----
    q = root_states[:, 3:7]
    vel = root_states[:, 7:10]

    qw = q[:, 0]
    qx = q[:, 1]
    qy = q[:, 2]
    qz = q[:, 3]

    # body forward axis (body x) in world frame
    fwd_x = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qy * qy + qz * qz)
    fwd_y = 2.0 * (qw * qz + qx * qy)
    fwd_z = 2.0 * (qx * qz - qw * qy)

    # body up axis (body z) in world frame
    up_x = 2.0 * (qw * qy + qx * qz)
    up_y = 2.0 * (-qw * qx + qy * qz)
    up_z = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)

    # horizontal projections (world z is up)
    fwd_norm = torch.sqrt(fwd_x * fwd_x + fwd_y * fwd_y + 1e-8)
    fwd_xh = fwd_x / fwd_norm
    fwd_yh = fwd_y / fwd_norm

    vx = vel[:, 0]
    vy = vel[:, 1]

    # signed forward speed along the facing direction
    fwd_speed = vx * fwd_xh + vy * fwd_yh
    # speed magnitude in the horizontal plane
    speed = torch.sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy + 1e-8)

    # ---------------- reward components ----------------
    # 1) exponential shaping of the gap between the current and the target forward speed
    speed_gap = torch.clamp(target_speed - fwd_speed, min=0.0)
    speed_exp = torch.exp(-speed_gap / speed_temperature)

    # 2) dense linear reward for the forward speed (pushes beyond the target speed)
    speed_lin = torch.clamp(fwd_speed / max_speed, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # 3) heading alignment: face (and therefore run along) the world forward direction
    heading_cos = fwd_xh   # cosine with world +x
    heading_exp = torch.exp(-(1.0 - heading_cos) / align_temperature)

    # 4) keep the torso upright
    upright = torch.exp(-(1.0 - up_z) / upright_temperature)

    reward = w_speed_exp * speed_exp + w_speed_lin * speed_lin + w_align * heading_exp + w_upright * upright
```

import torch


@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # hyper parameters (named, non-input variables)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    target_speed = 2.0          # desired forward speed [m/s]
    speed_temperature = 1.0     # temperature of the exponential speed shaping
    align_temperature = 0.3     # temperature of the exponential heading alignment
    upright_temperature = 0.5   # temperature of the exponential upright shaping
    max_speed = 6.0             # speed used to normalize the dense linear term
    w_speed_exp = 1.0
    w_speed_linear = 0.5
    w_heading = 0.4
    w_world_forward = 0.25
    w_upright = 0.1

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # unpack the root state: [pos(3), quat(4), lin_vel(3), ang_vel(3)]
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    quat = root_states[:, 3:7]
    lin_vel = root_states[:, 7:10]

    qw = quat[:, 0]
    qx = quat[:, 1]
    qy = quat[:, 2]
    qz = quat[:, 3]

    # body forward axis (body +x) expressed in the world frame
    fwd_x = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qy * qy + qz * qz)
    fwd_y = 2.0 * (qw * qz + qx * qy)
    fwd_z = 2.0 * (qx * qz - qw * qy)

    # body up axis (body +z) expressed in the world frame
    up_x = 2.0 * (qw * qy + qx * qz)
    up_y = 2.0 * (-qw * qx + qy * qz)
    up_z = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)

    # horizontal (world z is up) unit vector pointing where the ant faces
    fwd_norm = torch.sqrt(fwd_x * fwd_x + fwd_y * fwd_y + 1e-8)
    fwd_xh = fwd_x / fwd_norm
    fwd_yh = fwd_y / fwd_norm

    vel_x = lin_vel[:, 0]
    vel_y = lin_vel[:, 1]

    # signed speed along the direction the ant is facing
    forward_speed = vel_x * fwd_xh + vel_y * fwd_yh
    # speed along the world forward axis (+x)
    world_forward_speed = vel_x

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # reward components
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1) exponential shaping of the gap between current and target speed
    speed_gap = torch.clamp(target_speed - forward_speed, min=0.0)
    forward_speed_exp = torch.exp(-speed_gap / speed_temperature)

    # 2) dense linear term that keeps pushing the ant to run faster
    forward_speed_linear = torch.clamp(forward_speed / max_speed, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # 3) heading alignment: the ant has to face the forward direction
    heading_cos = fwd_xh
    heading_alignment = torch.exp(-(1.0 - heading_cos) / align_temperature)

    # 4) progress along the world forward axis
    world_forward_linear = torch.clamp(world_forward_speed / max_speed, min=0.0, max=1.0)

    # 5) keep the torso upright
    upright = torch.exp(-(1.0 - up_z) / upright_temperature)

    total = (w_speed_exp * forward_speed_exp
             + w_speed_linear * forward_speed_linear
             + w_heading * heading_alignment
             + w_world_forward * world_forward_linear
             + w_upright * upright)

    reward = total

    components = {
        "forward_speed_exp": forward_speed_exp,
        "forward_speed_linear": forward_speed_linear,
        "heading_alignment": heading_alignment,
        "world_forward_linear": world_forward_linear,
        "upright": upright,
        "forward_speed": forward_speed,
    }
    return reward, components
